# Task 057 shared XML Schema 1.0 `duration` lexical corpus.
#
# ONE corpus drives the generated Ada, Rust and C++ validators (named and
# direct carriers alike). Authority: XML Schema 1.0 Part 2 Second Edition,
# section 3.2.6.1 (datatypes.html, SHA-256 980de872...):
#
#   PnYnMnDTnHnMnS; Y/M/D/H/M are [0-9]+; seconds are [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?;
#   an optional preceding '-'; a zero component may be omitted, but at least
#   one number and designator must be present; 'T' is absent if and only if
#   every time item is absent; 'P' is always present. "P-1347M is not
#   allowed although -P1347M is allowed. P1Y2MT is not allowed."
#
# Negative zero: the rule admits the optional '-' for EVERY lexical form and
# restricts no component value, so -P0D is a legal lexical representation.
# Its value is the zero duration; this carrier stores the spelling unchanged.
#
# whiteSpace is fixed at collapse (4.3.6): the constructor collapses, then
# validates, then stores the collapsed spelling. Nothing is canonicalized.
#
# Format: `VALID input => stored` / `INVALID input` / bare `INVALID` for "".
# Escapes: \s space, \t tab, \n LF, \r CR, \\ backslash.

VALID P0D => P0D
VALID PT0S => PT0S
VALID P1Y => P1Y
VALID P2M => P2M
VALID P3D => P3D
VALID PT4H => PT4H
VALID PT5M => PT5M
VALID PT6S => PT6S
VALID PT6.25S => PT6.25S
VALID P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S => P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S
VALID P1Y2M3DT4H5M6.789S => P1Y2M3DT4H5M6.789S
VALID -P1D => -P1D
VALID -P0D => -P0D
VALID -PT0.0S => -PT0.0S
VALID -P1347M => -P1347M
VALID P1347Y => P1347Y
VALID P1347M => P1347M
VALID P1Y2MT2H => P1Y2MT2H
VALID P0Y1347M => P0Y1347M
VALID P0Y1347M0D => P0Y1347M0D
VALID P1Y2M3DT10H30M => P1Y2M3DT10H30M
VALID -P120D => -P120D
VALID P1DT2H => P1DT2H
VALID PT1H30M => PT1H30M
VALID PT0.000000000000000000000000000001S => PT0.000000000000000000000000000001S
VALID P999999999999999999999999999999999999Y => P999999999999999999999999999999999999Y
VALID P00012Y0000M => P00012Y0000M
VALID PT99999999999999999999999999999999999999H99999999999999999999999999999999999999M => PT99999999999999999999999999999999999999H99999999999999999999999999999999999999M
VALID P12M => P12M
VALID PT36H => PT36H
VALID \s\tP1DT2H\s\n => P1DT2H
VALID \r\n-P1Y\t => -P1Y
VALID \s\s\sPT0S\s\s\s => PT0S

INVALID
